summary: Newly renovated apartment · High spec design throughout · Available August 2024 · Two bedrooms with two bathrooms · Excellent Sandyford location
description:
A stunning newly renovated two bedroom apartment in an excellent Sandyford location.

My Property Box are thrilled to welcome to the Lettings market this fabulous high end apartment, location on the popular Portland Terrace, Sandyford. Finished to an extremely high standard throughout, the apartment offers a contemporary design with spacious light & airy rooms. The large open-plan living room / kitchen encapsulates the apartment's aim to provide modern and stylish living in the heart of Sandyford.

The Tour

Split over two floors, the apartment is entered through a secure communal front door with access to the apartment via a private entrance. The living room / kitchen provides an excellent hosting space, with breakfast bar and fully integrated appliances. Two generous double bedrooms, both offering ample storage space along with en-suite bathrooms, equipped with marbled tiling and tasteful fixtures. Additionally, the apartment comes with private off-street parking.

Available from August, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
